cohort: The study included 170,572 women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) having singleton, nonanomalous births in California between 2007 and 2011, comparing those with and without antenatal depression.
finding: Women with GDM and antenatal depression had significantly higher rates of preeclampsia, gestational hypertension, and preterm delivery (<37 and <34 weeks gestational age) compared to women with GDM alone.
